fields.description: Issue includes local commentary and humor columns alongside political coverage of a public rally featuring Jim Carson and Sidney J. Catts in the Florida governor’s race, with references to other candidates. Reports and satire address the ongoing Quigg trial involving Miami police, concerns about bootleg liquor and enforcement activity, and civic matters such as street conditions and the Miami City Club opening. The issue also promotes and discusses the forthcoming Shrine convention in Miami, includes entertainment and sports notices (boxing, theater, nightlife), and carries numerous local advertisements and paid political ads.
